# Bug report template

| Field | Content |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Short, observable failure |
| Repro | Numbered steps from a clean start |
| Expected | Oracle |
| Actual | What happened |
| Severity | blocker / critical / major / minor / trivial (+ why) |
| Evidence | Link or inline snippet (no secrets) |
| Env | Build / URL role / account role |
| Impact | Who breaks and how wide |
